judgements.justification: Only A's vTqw raised the d-decreasing Theorem 10 term; the authors posted a refined bound and a [ZCH+20] comparison on A's forum, vTqw raised to 7, and B never saw them.
Neither committee had a lone high-confidence expert rating above lower-confidence reviewers; B's confidence-4 reviewers gave the low scores (4, 6).
No reviewer added a new objection after the response period; TpjV's edit does not change its stated objections, and c6Mx's 4 was rebutted.
The notes find B's supporters no cooler than A's (B's mean without c6Mx is 7.0), so the gap is not a scoring-scale difference.
No reviewer or AC in either committee judged the headline claim or title overstated.
A's unsure reviewers gave 6 and 7 yet A awarded a spotlight, and B's poster rests on a confident detractor, not flat marginal-accept scores.
